headline: Drought and lower energy production affected Hidroelectrica's profitability in the third quarter
summary: Hidroelectrica's revenues rose 7% in the July-September period, but net profit fell 26% as drought and lower energy production weighed. Nine-month net profit rose 34% to 3.1 billion lei.
why: Hidroelectrica is Romania's largest hydropower producer, so its output is sensitive to rainfall and water levels.
